deviations.observed: The Lead planned a compiled Rust crate, but the allowed paths did not contain a build manifest. The worker's progress breaker blocked the Run instead of inventing success.
deviations.disposition: The live test project was given a minimal Cargo.toml plus src/lib.rs, which is a valid managed repository. The Lead prompt now warns not to assume a manifest that is not visible in source context.

deviations.observed: Core blocked with 'action must be explicitly classified R0 before autonomous start'.
deviations.disposition: Core now allows an unassessed Action when the frozen plan is deterministically R0 and the owner policy grants autonomous R0 start.

deviations.observed: Core blocked with 'execution policy delegation exceeds the frozen profile authority'.
deviations.disposition: Profile authorization validation now recognizes an autonomous grant only when the frozen profile enables auto-start for R0.

limitations: Implementer browser self-test, not independent verifier or Product Owner acceptance.
The project is a disposable local fixture with a minimal Rust scaffold; it is not a production repository.
Autonomous Gate repair remains disabled. A blocked or repair-required result needs a new authorized request or operator action.
The Issues auto-start remains browser-side; this autopilot covers unified intake requests, not a Core issue scheduler.
No isolation or security certification is claimed. TRUSTED_LOCAL remains broad local access.
